summary.prose: Keep the existing macOS supervisor, migration and client work. Add signed release verification, portable native build evidence and a guarded restoration path. Qualify real macOS builds before release promotion and verify Linux compatibility.

tasks.title: Stage and qualify pinned macOS releases
tasks.summary: Prepare a candidate beside the installed release using the configured origin and preserve an executable rollback pin.
acceptanceChecks: Candidate staging does not mutate the legacy checkout, runtime, dependencies or state.
Trusted compatibility evidence pins both releases, including qualified old releases without declarations. Unqualified or changed predecessors fail before shutdown.

tests.name: Release provenance, changed bytes and absent legacy declaration
Staging leaves the installed release executable and unchanged

tasks.title: Activate the supervisor on fresh install
tasks.summary: Journal fresh activation and route normal installation through it.
acceptanceChecks: A fresh install registers exactly one supervisor and verifies its child readiness. --no-start registers a usable idle supervisor.
Failure or interruption reconciles the selector, descriptor, job and optional child by identity.

tests.name: Explicit fresh activation start intent and owned partial publication
Fresh controller activation reconciles partial selector and bootstrap

tasks.title: Identify and fence legacy launch routes
tasks.summary: Discover a qualified predecessor and isolate the canonical launcher before cutover.
acceptanceChecks: Verified direct, passive job, temporary recovery job and stopped predecessors carry exact pins and compatible journal variants.
An already-running legacy helper, foreign job, unknown path or descriptor conflict refuses cutover before shutdown. The journaled dispatcher exchange can be resumed or reversed.

tests.name: Predecessor variants and backward decoding
Old shell/helper concurrent with canonical launcher exchange and old child attempting to open stores

tasks.title: Transfer the run-file guard without a gap
tasks.summary: Define authenticated transfer, receipts, and recovery across exact predecessor exit and supervisor startup.
acceptanceChecks: The old process exits with independent incarnation evidence. Graceful, broker-denied and unknown outcomes are distinguished only with correlated evidence.

The supervisor adopts the exact guard without releasing it in between. Old handles cannot mutate it. Crashes before and after transfer are recoverable, including an idle candidate and legacy rollback.
The transfer binds both incarnations to a durable receipt and proves the former owner cannot use its stale handle.

tests.name: Graceful, broker-denied and unknown drain evidence
Guard adoption binds exact identities and recovers on either side of transfer

tasks.title: Commit or roll back legacy migration
tasks.summary: Integrate the predecessor variants and guard with the existing transaction.
acceptanceChecks: Candidate startup or idle state is verified before durable success. Unknown terminal publication keeps the fence and resolves the matching durable outcome before rollback decisions.

Restore the exact previous registration even if it was idle. An idle descriptor that would autostart is refused before mutation unless there is a verified way to preserve idle. Direct rollback restores the previous running state and uses pinned launch settings.

tests.name: Uncertain publication with durable success versus no outcome
Startup guard transfer, candidate bootstrap failure, rollback and repeated recovery
Rollback restores an idle job without launching and refuses unqualified RunAtLoad

tasks.title: Wire running and stopped daemon updates
tasks.summary: Connect shell, TUI and the daemon update endpoint to shared staging and migration.
acceptanceChecks: Running managed update returns a bounded acknowledgement before detached fetch, install or build. Slow preparation can exceed both current deadlines without dropping an admitted update or shutting down the predecessor early.
Stopped managed update works without daemon IPC and leaves the replacement stopped. The legacy first-upgrade entry stages the bridge before calling old shutdown.
An unconfirmed acknowledgement cancels bounded admission before preparation or shutdown. Once acknowledged, the detached helper owns preparation and outcome even if the client disconnects.

tests.name: Running managed update IPC and stopped local managed update
Managed update acknowledges before slow preparation and survives client disconnect

tasks.title: Wire normal IDE first-upgrade actions
tasks.summary: Route VS Code and JetBrains installed update actions through the shared installer bridge on unmanaged macOS.
acceptanceChecks: Updated IDE lifecycle and freshness flows stage the migration before legacy shutdown and report verified outcomes.
Older callers can use the current normal installer as the first-upgrade entry without manual launchd or file edits. Managed clients keep the existing IPC outcome contract.

tests.name: Installer and updated CLI, VS Code and JetBrains route matrix

tasks.title: Verify signed release and trust metadata
tasks.summary: Add the trusted bootstrap verification contract and admission evidence.
acceptanceChecks: Bind source, branch, candidate tree and ordered releases to a scoped signature. Reject invalid, expired, revoked or replayed metadata and retain the durable receipt for offline recovery.

tests.name: Trust rotation, expiry, replay and offline rollback at the fence boundary

tasks.title: Verify the installed runtime inventory
tasks.summary: Measure the complete execution inventory and produce the exact local rollback pin.
acceptanceChecks: Reject unexpected executable files, unsafe links and unsupported optional package layouts. Retain every qualified file in the raw rollback pin and revalidate it at cutover.

tests.name: Changed native code, loadable data, bindings, signature policy, injected modules, symlinks and unidentified variance fail closed

tasks.title: Verify supported native build variance
tasks.summary: Verify signed reference equivalence for the named native add-ons.
acceptanceChecks: Independent unequal-length build roots verify against the same signed reference. Changed executable data, loader relationships, layout or signature coverage fail closed.

tests.name: Independent same-commit macOS build equivalence and tamper rejection
Independent unequal-length debug roots preserve canonical native identity and malformed offsets or codeLimit are rejected

tasks.title: Authenticate installer and IDE bootstrap
tasks.summary: Run the trusted first-stage verifier before candidate-controlled execution.
acceptanceChecks: Shell and both IDE installer routes refuse missing or invalid authorization before bridge checkout, npm scripts or bridge execution. Preserve existing fresh and Linux behavior.

tests.name: Invalid or missing authorization prevents bootstrap checkout execution, npm scripts and bridge invocation

tasks.title: Gate restored legacy lifecycle requests
tasks.summary: Preserve exact rollback using a guarded adapter, authenticated drain and durable fenced settlement.
acceptanceChecks: A restored process gates both lifecycle RPCs across applicable workers. The private controller drain requires the current reservation and exact peer. Verify restored state and publish rollback before permitting guarded dispatch.

tests.name: A competing legacy command and interruption during rollback cannot reopen the launcher before durable outcome
Real restored legacy update and shutdown RPCs cannot interrupt rollback or a managed retry
Idle public stop and authorized private drain require distinct admission and reconcile exact exit

tasks.title: Reserve restored upgrades before preparation
tasks.summary: Apply continuous preparation-to-cutover admission to the actual restored installer route.
acceptanceChecks: Arbitrate Stop and Update before fetch or build and preserve the exact incumbent baseline. Cleanly release a failed or abandoned pre-mutation reservation. Preserve managed acknowledgement before slow preparation.

tests.name: A restored installer reserves before fetch, build or inventory and releases admission on preparation failure
Managed acknowledgement precedes a preparation exceeding the client deadlines and lost reply cancels only unstarted work

tasks.title: Qualify install, migration and rollback
tasks.summary: Exercise supported paths against disposable macOS state and verify Linux behavior.
acceptanceChecks: Fresh install and --no-start, ordinary restart, running and stopped updates, and first upgrade of broker-denied predecessors pass real macOS qualification.
Interrupted guard adoption, stopped-job rollback and publication ambiguity are verified. User config and state survive. Linux lifecycle remains compatible.

Record immutable real-product qualification receipts for each enabled profile, using an isolated signer and exercising independent native builds, real running broker denial, stopped and passive routes, and the subsequent managed update.

tests.name: Linux normal install, update and restart unchanged
Fresh install and verified ordinary restart
Fresh --no-start and later supervisor start
First supported update of a qualified prior build with broker denial
Direct install and passive recovery job with exact loader argv
Verified stopped and running rollback with configuration and store integrity
Real product passive and recovery job loader arguments, verified broker refusal, data-preserving rollback and subsequent managed update

tasks.title: Gate promotion on published product qualification
tasks.summary: Produce and verify release evidence for the product matrix and enforce it before promotion.
acceptanceChecks: Publication verifies the exact release head, signed profiles and immutable real-product receipts from independent builds. Refuse missing or invalid evidence before promotion. Use a disposable signer for tests.

tests.name: Missing or stale release evidence prevents promotion and leaves the incumbent running
Release publication validates real running and stopped upgrades for every enabled profile
